io_adaptations_and_checks: Model matrices read from JSON (shared LGSSM contract), converted to float64 jnp arrays; upstream names semigroup/trans_cov/obs_op/obs_cov/m0/v0 = F/Q/H/R/m0/P0.

Shape checks derived from H (dy, dx); finiteness of all inputs; symmetry of Q, R, P0 (rtol 1e-10, atol 1e-12) because jnp.linalg.cholesky reads only the lower triangle and would silently use an asymmetric matrix.
ys of shape (T+1,) is accepted only when dy == 1 and reshaped to (T+1, 1); the upstream test_kf itself passes 1-D ys for dy=1 and both forms gave bitwise-identical results in the smoke check.

Post-call guards (no recomputation): non-finite KF nll -> error (H P H^T + R not PD; upstream Cholesky returns NaN silently); non-finite RTS output or gradient -> error; non-finite simulation -> error (Q, R, P0 must be PD). No PD check is done before calling upstream.

No scientific transformation added. Gradient is w.r.t. the full matrices F and H (general case of the demo's scalar parametrisation; chain rule sum(dF*I), sum(dH*ones) reproduces the demo's grad_true bitwise). Only Frobenius norms of gradients are returned; full arrays go to the npz.
